info.title: Q-Flow API Documentation
info.description: REST API documentation for Q-Flow Queue Management System

get.summary: Get live status of a queue ticket

400.description: Ticket cannot be cancelled from current state

get.summary: List all counters and their assigned staff
get.description: Returns every counter desk, whether it's currently staffed, and who's assigned — used to populate the active-desk selector.

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

get.summary: Get the ticket currently being served at a counter

parameters.name: employeeId
parameters.description: Employee ID of the staff member assigned to the counter

200.description: Current ticket for the counter, or null if the desk is idle

404.description: Counter not found for the given employee

get.summary: Get the list of tickets waiting to be called to this counter

parameters.name: employeeId
parameters.description: Employee ID of the staff member assigned to the counter

404.description: Counter not found for the given employee

post.summary: Call the next waiting ticket to this counter

parameters.name: employeeId
parameters.description: Employee ID of the staff member assigned to the counter

200.description: Next ticket successfully called to the counter

404.description: No waiting tickets in queue, or counter not found

patch.description: Generic status transition endpoint — e.g. marking a ticket SERVED, CANCELLED, or SKIPPED.

400.description: Invalid status value or illegal transition from current status

post.summary: Re-send the counter-call notification for a ticket
post.description: Re-notifies the customer (via their preferred channel) that they're being called, without changing ticket status.

200.description: Login successful, returns JWT token and user info

429.description: Too many login attempts, rate limited

post.summary: Bind staff member to a counter for the active shift

400.description: Counter is already occupied or invalid counterId

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

post.summary: Unbind staff member from active counter shift

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

get.summary: Generate the branch check-in QR code
get.description: Returns both a PNG data URL (for previews/downloads) and an SVG string (for print/signage) pointing at the customer self-service check-in URL.

200.description: List of all counters, ordered by counter number

patch.summary: Enable or disable a service counter
patch.description: Deactivating a counter automatically force-unbinds any staff member currently assigned to it.

post.summary: Force unbind staff assigned to a counter
post.description: Unconditionally clears the counter's currently bound staff member, regardless of whether one is assigned.

post.summary: Provision a new staff or admin user

employeeId.description: 3-20 characters; letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

password.description: Min 8 characters, must include uppercase, lowercase, and a digit.

400.description: Employee ID already registered, or employeeId/fullName/password failed validation

200.description: List of system users, newest first

post.summary: Reset password for a specific user

newPassword.description: Min 8 characters, must include uppercase, lowercase, and a digit.

message.example: Password successfully reset for employee ID: STF-010

get.summary: Retrieve queue tickets with filtering, search, and pagination

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match against ticket number, customer name, or phone number

200.description: Paginated list of tickets, newest first

post.summary: Insert a high-priority (VIP) ticket at the front of the queue
post.description: Shifts all currently WAITING tickets back one position and inserts the new ticket at position 1.

201.description: Priority ticket created and placed at head of queue

patch.summary: Manually override a ticket's status or details
patch.description: All fields are optional and applied independently — e.g. you can update just customerName without touching status. Setting status to a terminal value (SERVED, CANCELLED, AUTO_CANCELLED, SKIPPED) stamps the corresponding timestamp automatically.

reason.description: Included in the real-time broadcast event; not persisted on the ticket record.

200.description: Today's operational overview, wait/service times, and status breakdown

avgWaitTimeMinutes.description: Average time from joining to being serviced, in minutes. Null if no tickets were served today.

avgServiceTimeMinutes.description: Average time spent in service, in minutes. Null if no tickets were served today.

statusBreakdown.description: Count of today's tickets per status

get.summary: Get today's performance metrics per counter staff member

200.description: Per-staff ticket counts and average handling time for today

activeCounter.description: "Unbound" if the staff member isn't currently assigned to a counter.

avgHandlingTimeMinutes.description: Null if the staff member hasn't completed any tickets today.
